articles.title: Lightning Houthi advance in Yemen may bring dangerous new dimension to Iran war
articles.description: The capture by the rebels of a stretch Yemen's strategic coastline is the group's most impressive military coup for several years.

articles.title: Israel strike on Hezbollah tunnel triggers earthquake-like tremor
articles.description: Israel has destroyed a network of Hezbollah tunnels in southern Lebanon - triggering a 4.1 magnitude tremor in the area.

articles.title: Half a million Russians killed in Ukraine war, British intelligence says
articles.description: Half a million Russian soldiers have been killed in Vladimir Putin's full-scale war against Ukraine, according to British military intelligence.

articles.title: Anthropic blocks efforts to use AI to research weapons development and carry out cyber attacks
articles.description: Anthropic says it has blocked efforts to use its artificial intelligence models to carry out cyber attacks and research which could have led to the creation of biological weapons.
